paths.catalyst: A documented funding deadline, maturity, cash milestone or financing announcement inside the affordable hold window.
confirm: Reconcile unrestricted cash, quarterly operating burn and maintenance capital spending.
Read commitments, minimum-liquidity covenants, maturities, ATM capacity and signed funding terms.
Model base, adverse and no-new-financing runway; distinguish an approved shelf from committed cash.
paths.contrary: Positive recurring cash generation or committed financing extends runway without the hypothesized per-share damage.
paths.falsifier: Define the minimum unrestricted cash/runway or acceptable funding terms that would invalidate the funding gap.
paths.hypothesis: Recurring cash consumption may force financing that damages common-equity value.
paths.label: Cash runway → financing pressure
paths.limit: The quantitative runway uses reported cash and trailing CFO; restricted cash, seasonality, capex and future funding require reconciliation.

paths.catalyst: A dated collection, reserve, contract renewal or reporting event that can change the market's cash/earnings belief.
confirm: Bridge net income to CFO line by line, including stock compensation and non-cash charges.
Compare receivables, contract assets, reserves and collections against comparable sales periods.
Read revenue policies, returns, payment terms and customer concentration; quantify the specific adjustment.
paths.contrary: A documented seasonal reversal, collections catching up, or ordinary non-cash charges explain the gap.
paths.falsifier: State which collections or reconciled accrual reversal would remove the earnings-quality concern.
paths.hypothesis: A reported earnings/cash gap may reflect poor collections, non-recurring accruals or a benign non-cash/seasonal explanation.
paths.label: Earnings / cash gap → earnings-quality review
paths.limit: An accrual ratio does not identify revenue manipulation, establish fraud or prove reported profits exist. Parent and child accounting labels share the same evidence.

paths.catalyst: A dated earnings, contract reset, capacity addition or restructuring milestone that exposes the margin mechanism.
confirm: Separate price, volume, mix, utilization and input/labor costs in segment results.
Remove identified one-off restructuring or acquisition charges without ignoring recurring economic costs.
Test whether competition, customer terms and unit economics imply durable damage rather than a normal cycle.
paths.contrary: A temporary cost or utilization shock reverses and filed segment/unit economics support sustainable recovery.
paths.falsifier: Set the segment margin, price/volume or unit-economics recovery that contradicts the impairment case.
paths.hypothesis: Worsening margins may reveal declining pricing power, adverse mix or structural costs that the valuation has not reflected.
paths.label: Margin deterioration → operating failure hypothesis
paths.limit: Aggregate margin decline alone cannot distinguish structural impairment, investment spending and cyclicality.

paths.catalyst: A dated customer renewal, product milestone or reporting event that tests the stated demand mechanism.
confirm: Reconcile organic growth, acquisitions, currency and comparable periods.
Read customer/product concentration, bookings, cancellations, backlog conversion and retention disclosures.
Compare management's demand explanation with segment data and identified competing supply.
paths.contrary: Order timing, currency or disposed operations explain the slowdown and comparable organic demand remains healthy.
paths.falsifier: Define the renewal, order conversion or comparable organic growth that would refute demand decay.
paths.hypothesis: Slower revenue growth may expose weak demand, customer concentration or product decay rather than a sustainable growth franchise.
paths.label: Revenue slowdown → demand and concentration review
paths.limit: Revenue slowdown and margin deterioration often describe the same operating mechanism; counting both labels does not establish independent corroboration.

paths.catalyst: An identified maturity, covenant test or refinancing deadline supported by a filed agreement.
confirm: Reconcile all maturities, interest costs, collateral, revolvers, guarantees and off-balance-sheet commitments.
Calculate covenant and minimum-liquidity headroom from the actual agreement definitions.
Model common-equity value under refinancing, asset-sale and no-refinancing cases.
paths.contrary: Ample covenant headroom and committed affordable funding resolve the maturity/liquidity problem.
paths.falsifier: Specify the signed refinancing terms or covenant headroom that remove the common-equity impairment.
paths.hypothesis: Debt service, covenant constraints or refinancing terms may transfer value away from common equity.
paths.label: Leverage → refinancing and equity-claim review
paths.limit: A debt/assets ratio or negative book equity does not establish a near-term default; dates and agreement terms require manual review.

paths.catalyst: A documented issuance, conversion, reset or funding event with explicit terms and a date.
confirm: Reconcile shares outstanding, issuance proceeds, warrant/convert strikes and reset clauses from primary documents.
Build fully diluted common-equity values with debt, preferred claims, restricted proceeds and transaction costs.
Distinguish economic dilution from the mechanical reverse-split share adjustment.
paths.contrary: Financing creates enough per-share value or non-dilutive cash runway to offset the added claims.
paths.falsifier: Define acceptable fully diluted shares and net proceeds/value creation that negate the dilution thesis.
paths.hypothesis: Actual issuance, warrants or converts may impair common-equity value per share even if enterprise operations survive.
paths.label: Issuance terms → per-share dilution review
paths.limit: Manual-only route. Changes in book equity are not proof of issuance, and reverse splits alone earn no impairment points.

paths.catalyst: A scheduled restatement, auditor/reporting update or other documented event that tests the disclosure issue.
confirm: Diff the exact note, audit opinion, control disclosure or KPI definition against the comparable filing.
Quantify the change and retain management's explanation and any subsequent correction.
Use a specific observed allegation-free tag; accounting conclusions require analyst review.
paths.contrary: Primary documents resolve the apparent discrepancy or show a required disclosure update without economic impairment.
paths.falsifier: Specify the corrected/reconciled disclosure that would remove the stated accounting concern.
paths.hypothesis: A specific accounting-policy, auditor or adjusted-metric change may undermine the reported earnings or disclosure baseline.
paths.label: Disclosure changes → reporting-integrity review
paths.limit: Manual-only route. Material weaknesses and auditor changes are research leads, not fraud findings.

paths.catalyst: A documented vote, transaction, lockup or contract event affecting outside common-equity value.
confirm: Read proxy, ownership, related-party notes, compensation and instrument terms.
Reconcile any claimed insider sales to actual Form 4 transactions, plans and ownership changes.
Quantify the economic transfer and retain the documented arm's-length or business explanation.
paths.contrary: Primary documents show ordinary terms and aligned incentives or resolve the claimed economic transfer.
paths.falsifier: State which terms or ownership reconciliation would eliminate the adverse payoff hypothesis.
paths.hypothesis: Documented control rights, incentives or related-party terms may create an adverse payoff for outside common shareholders.
paths.label: Control and incentives → common-equity payoff review
paths.limit: Manual-only route. Promotion, insider activity and related-party labels cannot be inferred from ordinary cash-flow or reverse-split data.

research_plan.purpose: Use fundamentals to discover a testable mechanism, Short Alpha to organize the hypothesis, and filing-furnace evidence to earn or weaken conviction.

score_contract.evidence: Existing six-lens documentation grade; unknown remains unscored and generated prompts cannot raise it.
score_contract.fundamental: Existing SSI numerical deterioration score; unchanged by selected frameworks.
score_contract.independence: Accounting parent/child tags share evidence. Cash burn, leverage and dilution belong to funding; revenue and margins belong to operations. Explain a distinct causal mechanism before treating related observations as corroboration.
score_contract.tradability: Existing quote, locate, catalyst, payoff and shared-account gates remain separate.

stages.deliverable: A dated issuer/instrument identity and comparable financial series with filing accession and source locators.
stages.label: 1 · Reconcile the facts
stages.next: Read the actual notes and exhibits for restricted cash, custom tags and capital claims.

stages.deliverable: One primary hypothesis, supporting frameworks and an explicit causal chain from the changed fact to common-equity damage.
stages.label: 2 · Choose the short mechanism
stages.next: Separate correlated warnings and state what the market appears to believe.

stages.deliverable: Dated strengthening and weakening claims, prior/new values, exact sources and a falsifier; review all six lenses.
stages.label: 3 · Run the filing furnace
stages.next: Review the suggested routes manually. Generated prompts carry no supporting-evidence grade.

stages.deliverable: Bear/base/bull common-equity values, financing/dilution assumptions, catalyst window and the bullish recovery case.
stages.label: 4 · Connect mechanism to payoff
stages.next: Enter the scenario assumptions; current RSI-1.0 checks target downside, timing and carry without estimating probabilities.

stages.deliverable: Verified quote/locate and size against account-wide margin, correlated squeezes and the cost of waiting.
stages.label: 5 · Make the short survivable
stages.next: Reconcile live holdings and owner cash flows through the SSI handoff before measuring incremental portfolio risk.

stages.deliverable: Frozen forward decisions including passes; later collect fills, costs, daily equity and external flows.
stages.label: 6 · Test the combination
stages.next: Compare split-only, fundamentals-only and combined sleeves on the same universe/capital rules. Stratify by mechanism and sector without selecting a winning historical threshold.
